plot: The morning after Halloween Max sneaks up on Grandma's bitten pumpkin lantern to find the biter, pokes his head inside and gets stuck right before the neighbours' pumpkin-soup lunch; Dog's gentle tail pull only rolls them across the grass, until Bird peeks through the tiny bite hole and sees Max's ears standing up like hooks, so everyone goes quiet in 'sneak mode', Max's ears go flat and he slides out with the pumpkin uncracked; the biter turns out to be a squirrel stuffing its cheeks with seeds, and Max wants to befriend it tomorrow.

script.title: Max's Head Is Stuck in a Pumpkin

beats.say: Help! Help! My head is stuck in Grandma's pumpkin!
Whoa! Max is a pumpkin! A walking, talking pumpkin cat!
How do you get a cat out of a pumpkin?
How did this happen? Let's go back ten minutes.
It's a crisp autumn morning, the day after Halloween.
Grandma's pumpkin lantern still sits by the garden door.
Look! Someone took a tiny bite out of it!
A pumpkin biter, in our garden? I'll find out who!
Max goes into sneak mode. Low, and slow, and quiet.
In sneak mode, Max's ears go flat. Flat as pancakes.
Max, why are you walking like a fluffy carpet?
Shh! Sneak mode! The biter could be hiding inside!
Grandma cut a lid in the top for Halloween.
Max lifts the lid. He pushes his head in, deep.
It's dark in here. And it smells like soup.
No biter inside. Okay. Head out now. Pull!
But Max's head won't come out. Not even a little bit.
I'm stuck! I'm really, really stuck!
I twist left. I twist right. Nope! Still stuck!
Don't panic! But that's Grandma's soup pumpkin for lunch!
But Max can't stay still. All he can see is orange.
Where's the garden? Where's the sky? Where's my tail?
Max, stop! You're walking into Grandma's flowers!
Too late. Max walks right into the flower bed. Squish.
Sorry, flowers! I can't see you! Everything is orange!
Don't worry! I'll pull you out by your tail. Gently!
Dog holds Max's tail in his soft mouth. One, two, three...
Dog pulls back. Max goes back. The pumpkin goes too.
They roll across the grass like a big orange snowball.
Oops. Now we're both dizzy. And you're still a pumpkin.
Pulling made it worse. The pumpkin is hugging him tighter!
Oh my! Max! Is that my soup pumpkin on your head?
The neighbours are coming for pumpkin soup at lunch!
If the pumpkin cracks, there's no soup for the whole street!
And if it doesn't crack, I'm a pumpkin forever!
Nobody pulls. Nobody pushes. First we stay calm and look.
Inside the pumpkin, Max tries to be calm. He hums.
Hmm hmm hmmm... Hey! My voice is huge in here!
Hellooo! Hellooo! Hellooo!
Wow! The pumpkin is singing! Can it sing my bone song?
Then, from the old tree, a tiny sound. Chitter, chitter.
Did you hear that? Something up in the tree is giggling.
No time for that! Look, the neighbours are at the fence!
Over the fence, the neighbours wave. They hold empty soup bowls.
Soup bowls? Can I have the very first bowl?
Only a few minutes until lunch, my dears!
Hurry, friends! I don't want to be a pumpkin forever!
Wait! There's a little hole right here. The tiny bite!
Bird flies up and peeks through the tiny bite hole.
Hello in there! I see a nose. I see whiskers.
And your ears! They're standing straight up, like two hooks!
Up? But when Max sneaked in, his ears were flat!
Flat ears went in. Up ears can't come out!
I need sneak mode again. But I'm too wiggly!
Then let's all be very, very quiet. Sneak mode, everyone.
Everyone gets low and slow. Dog tiptoes. Bird whispers.
Shhh, Max. Sneak mode. Low, and slow, and quiet.
Max takes a big, calm breath. His ears go flat.
Now tip your chin down, and back out very slowly.
Max tips his chin down. He backs up. Slowly. Slowly...
I'm out! Hello, garden! Hello, sky! Hello, tail!
Clever ears, clever cat. And clever Bird, too.
And the pumpkin? Not one single crack!
Soup for everyone! And Max, you can stir the pot.
When you're stuck, don't pull harder. Stay calm, and think.
And maybe don't put your head in pumpkins.
But who took the tiny bite? Chitter, chitter, from the tree!
Look up! A little squirrel with an orange nose!
Squirrels hide seeds for winter. That's why it took a bite!
The pumpkin biter! And it's waving its fluffy tail at me!
The squirrel's cheeks are full of pumpkin seeds. Big, round cheeks.
Tomorrow, I'm going to make friends with that squirrel!

long.title: Max's Head Is STUCK in a Pumpkin! 🎃😹
long.description:
"I only wanted to find the pumpkin biter. Now I AM the pumpkin!" 🐱
The morning after Halloween Max peeks inside Grandma's soup pumpkin and gets his head stuck, just before the neighbours come for lunch. Max the Curious Cat, Ep 25.

#MaxTheCuriousCat #series #3DAnimation
